Warehouse location mapping

3,731 unique locations mapped · 0 unmapped
3289 aisle-section matches · 148 storage-zone matches · 167 drugs-room matches · 127 user-approved approximate placements.

All geometry and timing remain illustrative. Zone and room matches share an access point because their internal sections have not been drawn. Upstairs 20, 21, 22 and 25 occupy open space to the right with estimated positions. FA codes use the corresponding aisle front. 00 codes use the nearest relevant aisle front (unknown aisles: 4 downstairs, 9 for 7L, 11 upstairs). Other special locations, including the office code, sit beside packing. These are simulation assumptions, not recommendations to physically relocate stock.

Downstairs shelf levels 02 and above incur ladder time (814 locations). Upstairs locations never incur ladder time. The final shelf subdivision remains in the full code but does not add walking distance. Source: Pasted text(9).txt; row references include the header.
